chapter.verse: Pasian aw, nangma min tawh kei hong hon in la, na vaang tawh ka dikna kilangsak in.
Pasian aw, ka thungetna hong za in la, ka kampaute hong ngai in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mi kiphasakte in kei hong lang pang a, mi helhhawtte in thah dingin hong zong uh hi; amaute in Pasian thudon lo uh hi.
En in, Pasian in kei hong huhpa hi a, Topa in kei hong huhpa ahi hi.
Amah in ka galte siatna tawh thuk ding hi; na thumanna tawh amaute sumai in.
Utna lungsim tawh na tungah biakpiakna kong pia ding a, nang hoih na hih manin, na tungah lungdamna kong ko ding hi, Topa aw.
Bang hang hiam cih leh haksatna khempeuh panin kei nong honkhia khin a, ka galte a guallelhna ka mu khin hi.
